Team —

Read through Brian’s redlines and pulled what we can answer quickly. High-level guidance below; use this to draft the customer-facing Drive doc.

Open items and suggested language
- Controller/Processor: Confirm as requested: MedBridge = Controller; Redwood = Processor. We should cite Section 2 of our standard DPA and add a clarifying sentence: "Redwood acts as a processor on behalf of Controller for the described processing; any Subliminary contractor/subprocessor relationships are listed in Schedule A and governed by the DPA."

- Subprocessor notifications: We can commit to 24 hours for notification of confirmed incidents where a Redwood-managed subprocessor is involved and there is a plausible risk to customer data. Note: our technical detection window can vary; we should qualify "confirmed" and follow with an internal SLA: preliminary notice within 24 hours, detailed findings within 72 hours, final report within 14 days. Proposed wording: "Redwood will provide preliminary notification within 24 hours of confirmation of an incident involving a Redwood-managed subprocessor that materially affects the Customer’s Data, a more detailed interim report within 72 hours, and a final root-cause report within 14 days."

- Retention: We can support an automated purge of token-level logs at 30 days for this workload if customer agrees to US-only residency and dedicated retention policy. What we cannot do today: recover purged KV cache entries. Proposed messaging to customer: automated purge job daily; retention timestamp in audit logs; certification statement upon request (signed statement + export of timestamps).

- Evidence deliverables: We can provide export of: ingestion audit logs (with timestamps), stable delivery receipts, and a scoped export of model-run metadata (no raw model weights). For KV cache entries we can provide key hashes and last-access timestamps; raw cache blobs are not retained post-purge. Timeline: preliminary evidence package in 72 hours; full export in up to 7 business days depending on scope.

Action items
- Karthik: confirm whether a dedicated ingestion path and US-only routing can be guaranteed for a pilot (impact on cost + timeline).
- Jonas: propose the Drive doc (short playbook) and include the proposed notification wording above. Attach our standard DPA excerpt and the proposed redline response.
- I'll prepare the canned language and the evidence checklist to attach.
